name: SpaceBones
storyline:
Across the galaxy, derelict cargo ships, opportunistic pirates, and shadowy corporations float in unstable truce, all circling the same prey: NP, or Nuclear Pasta, the rarest and most unstable substance in the known universe. It fuels your ship. It buys your upgrades. And it paints a target on your back.

As you explore uncharted star systems, you’ll dock at shady outposts, convert your NP to fuel and repair kits, and weigh every decision because once you launch, you’re vulnerable. Other players can ambush you. AI raiders can hijack your cargo. And Lucy will never let you forget if you screw it up.

But fortune favors the bold. With enough cunning and cold-blooded PvP, you’ll climb the leaderboards, earn infamy, and become a legend among the SpaceBones.
summary:
SpaceBones.io is a pioneering voice‑driven MMO set in space, built entirely around Amazon Alexa. As a pirate captain guided by your AI assistant “Lucy,” you dock, launch, explore, loot, trade, and battle in an expanding galaxy—all through voice commands.

Dock and upgrade in star systems, leveling your ship by converting “NP” (Nuclear Pasta) into in‑game currency for fuel, repairs, and upgrades

Explore for treasure, cargo ships, and PVP opportunities, targeting loot from AI‑controlled vessels and fellow players to build your infamy .

Engage in true PVP with a risk‐and‐reward system—ships left launched become vulnerable to attacks while you're away

Track progress via leaderboards, with daily, weekly, monthly, and all‑time high‑score rankings .

Visually enhanced on Echo Show, the skill supports graphical maps and UI elements for star systems, market prices, and ship status.
